articles.title: 'Not the answer': Labour MPs speak out against Rosebank as decision looms
articles.summary: There is a growing expectation among senior Labour figures that drilling in the oil field will be given the green light.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: 'Not the answer': Labour MPs speak out against Rosebank as decision looms
articles.summaryTr: There is a growing expectation among senior Labour figures that drilling in the oil field will be given the green light.
articles.articleText: 'Not the answer': Labour MPs speak out against Rosebank as decision looms - Published Some Labour MPs have called on the government to reject the Rosebank oil field, saying it is "incompatible" with the UK's climate commitments. There is a growing expectation among senior Labour figures that drilling in the oil field off the north-west coast of Shetland will be given the go-ahead. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday that a decision would be "taken in due course" while Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh stressed that affordability of energy bills was her "overriding objective". But in a sign of the division within the party, more than a dozen Labour MPs expressed concerns in Parliament about approving it. Others expressed support, pointing to economic benefits. Supportive Labour MPs said some other parts of the world emitted far more greenhouse gases than the UK and warned of relying on imports. Reports have suggested that Chancellor John Healey is in favour of approval. Separately, it is understood some Labour backbenchers have organised a letter opposing Rosebank - intended for Burnham, but not yet sent - which more than 60 out of about 400 Labour MPs have indicated they support. One signatory told the BBC that approving Rosebank "would not create new jobs, would bring minimal money into the Treasury and be bad for the climate". "The government's central aim is to tackle the cost of living crisis, and drilling for more oil at Rosebank isn't the answer," the MP said. Wednesday's Westminster Hall - a type of parliamentary debate where backbench MPs raise topical issues but do not vote - was organised by Green MP Carla Denyer. Labour MP for Sheffield Central Abtisam Mohamed told the debate: "Rosebank fails on every test. "It will not benefit taxpayers who will shoulder the vast majority of the development costs, it will not strengthen our energy security because most of the oil will be sold on international markets, and it will not reduce energy bills for our constituents, who will remain exposed to volatile fossil fuel prices." Richard Burgon, a former frontbencher on the left of the party, said: "Rosebank is not compatible with our climate targets - it's dangerous to pretend otherwise." The UK is committed to reaching net zero by 2050 and wants to limit global warming to no more than 1.5C above the pre-industrial period. The UK government has always insisted that Rosebank is a quasi-judicial decision, formally resting with Fahnbulleh. She green-lit production in the Jackdaw gas field in the North Sea last month, but Rosebank hangs in the balance. Labour's manifesto upon entering power in 2024 pledged not to "issue new licences to explore new fields". Licences for both Jackdaw and Rosebank were granted by the then Conservative UK government in 2022 and 2023 respectively. But the Court of Session in Edinburgh ruled last year that the government had made the approvals unlawfully, leaving the current Labour government to make a fresh decision on whether to give the go-ahead. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch sought to tease at Labour divisions on the issue during Prime Minister's Questions on Wednesday. Demand for fossil fuels During the debate, Labour MP Anna Gelderd said: "We live in an unprecedented era where our energy security is more vital than ever, in which jobs and wealth must be protected and economic opportunities seized - on both of these points, Rosebank fails." Labour MP Julia Buckley said she had received opposition to Rosebank from her constituents in "regularly flooded Shrewsbury" and said fossil fuels "belong in the past, not the future". She urged Fahnbulleh to "reject the oil licence in favour of renewables", adding: "Please don't add further to our climate emergency." Other Labour MPs expressed their support, including recently departed veterans minister Al Carns, who warned that Britain would continue to need fossil fuels for decades and importing more would be a mistake. "Refusing to produce it here does nothing on its own to eliminate that demand - it simply increases our reliance on imports which can carry their own environmental cost," he added. Those representing communities with ties to the oil and gas industry, including Jonathan Brash, the Labour MP for Hartlepool, stressed the benefits of approving Rosebank for British jobs. Speaking to BBC Radio 5 Live, Labour MP Bill Esterson, chair of Energy Security and Net Zero Committee, said "the economics of it (Rosebank) are that you should carry on with it" and "there's an element of energy security" by approving it. Energy minister Michael Shanks told the debate the government would take a "pragmatic approach" to a clean energy transition, stressing it was "not a turn off the taps government, but nor can we justifiably be a drill every last drop government either". "This government will not make decisions for this country which are not compatible with our climate obligations," he added. - Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm - Published25 October - Action on energy costs is my overriding aim, says Fahnbulleh - Published2 days ago - Political battle intensifies within Labour over Rosebank oil field - Published26 October Sign up for our Politics Essential newsletter to keep up with the inner workings of Westminster and beyond.

Energy minister Michael Shanks told the debate the government would take a "pragmatic approach" to a clean energy transition, stressing it was "not a turn off the taps government, but nor can we justifiably be a drill every last drop government either". articles.articleText: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations. Japanese financial services giant Nomura Holdings is reportedly weighing a sale of its cryptocurrency subsidiary Laser Digital as Nomura’s European operations continue to post losses. Nomura has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex Group, Bloomberg reported Wednesday. The company has yet to make a final decision and could keep the business, according to the report. Nomura’s European businesses posted a pretax loss of 7.4 billion yen ($46.5 million) in the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026, their fourth consecutive quarterly loss. The company posted pretax profits in every other reporting region over the same period. Nomura did not disclose whether Laser Digital, which is headquartered in Switzerland, contributed to the European result. Nomura is one of Japan’s largest financial services groups, with its investment management division overseeing 152.8 trillion yen ($960 billion) in assets as of September 2026. The potential sale comes less than three months after Laser Digital Japan secured the country’s first new crypto exchange license in four years, allowing the firm to expand its institutional crypto trading services in Japan. Established in 2022, Laser Digital provides institutional cryptocurrency trading, asset management and venture investment services. The company has also pursued expansion in the United States, receiving preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for its proposed national trust bank in May. During a January earnings call, chief financial officer Hiroyuki Moriuchi said the company would reduce its cryptocurrency trading positions to limit short-term volatility while continuing to expand Laser Digital over the medium to long term. articles.summaryTr: Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç, enerji dönüşümünün ülkelerin bağımsızlığını ve rekabet gücünü belirleyen ekonomik bir zorunluluğa dönüştüğünü söyledi.
articles.articleText: Ali Koç: Enerji dönüşümü artık tercih değil, ekonomik mecburiyet - Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç, enerji dönüşümünün ülkelerin bağımsızlığını ve rekabet gücünü belirleyen ekonomik bir zorunluluğa dönüştüğünü söyledi. - Türkiye’nin Made in Europe kapsamı dışında kalması ihtimaline ilişkin “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım” diyen Koç, enerji dönüşümünün Türkiye’ye önemli fırsatlar sunduğunu vurguladı. - CEO Levent Çakıroğlu da Türkiye’de yatırımı bulunan Avrupalı üreticilerin, olası dışlanmanın değer zincirlerine vereceği zararı Avrupa’da dile getirdiğini söyledi. - Çakıroğlu ise topluluğun son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolarlık yatırım yaptığını açıkladı. Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç ve CEO Levent Çakıroğlu, Antalya’da COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen basın sohbetinde enerji dönüşümü, Avrupa’yla ticaret ve topluluğun yatırım planlarına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İklim mücadelesinde hedeflerden uygulamaya geçilmesi gerektiğini belirten Ali Koç, “Artık daha yeni hedeflere ihtiyaç yok. Ne yapılması gerektiği belli” dedi. Koç, “Artık yeter, konuşmayın, eylem yapın” dönemine gelinmesinin Türkiye için büyük bir fırsat sunduğunu ifade etti. COP31’in Türkiye’nin enerji vizyonunu vitrine koyması açısından da önemli bir buluşma olduğunu söyleyen Koç, organizasyonun hazırlık çalışmalarını takdir ettiğini belirtti. “İklim hedefleri ekonomik yarışa döndü” Rusya-Ukrayna Savaşı ve Hürmüz krizinin enerji güvenliğinin önemini artırdığını vurgulayan Koç, enerji maliyetlerindeki yükselişin enflasyondan seçim sonuçlarına kadar geniş bir alanda etkili olduğunu söyledi. Koç, Hürmüz krizinin ardından Türkiye’nin aylık enerji maliyetinin yüzde 49 arttığını belirterek enerji dönüşümünü şu sözlerle değerlendirdi: “Enerji dönüşümünün formülü enerji bağımsızlığı artı ekonomik rekabetçilik. Şimdi dünyada iklim hedefleri ekonomik yarışa döndü.” Yenilenebilir enerji ve elektrifikasyona yönelişin ekonomik gerekçelerle güçlendiğini ifade eden Koç, “Artık mecburiyet, tercih değil, ekonomik açıdan bir mecburiyet” dedi. Koç, Avrupa’nın regülasyon ve karbon fiyatlamasıyla, Çin’in ise ölçek, teknoloji ve devlet desteğiyle öne çıktığını söyledi. Kritik minerallerin ve bu minerallerin işlenmesine yönelik kapasitenin de yeni dönemin stratejik rekabet alanları arasında bulunduğunu belirtti. “Dünyada para gidecek yer arıyor, niye bize gelmesin?” Türkiye’nin enerji dönüşümünde önemli fırsatlara sahip olduğunu belirten Koç, bu dönüşümün başarısında liderliğin ve içinde bulunulan ekosistemin önemini vurguladı. Koç, “Dünyada o kadar çok para var ki. Para gidecek yer arıyor. Niye bize gelmesin? Bizde helva yapacak unu, şekeri, malzemesi hepsi var. Olay onu bir araya getirebilmek” ifadelerini kullandı. Türkiye’nin enerji ihtiyacının yaklaşık üçte ikisinde dışa bağımlı olduğunu söyleyen Koç, gerçekçi, uygulanabilir ve finanse edilebilir bir enerji stratejisiyle ülkenin 10 yıl sonra çok farklı bir noktaya ulaşabileceğini belirtti. Koç, Türkiye’nin mühendislik kapasitesine, sanayisinin gelişimine ve bulunduğu bölgenin ihtiyaçlarına dikkat çekerek, “Bu dönüşümün değer zincirinde bir pozisyon alma imkânımız fazlasıyla var” dedi. Made in Europe uyarısı: “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım” Türkiye’nin Made in Europe yaklaşımının dışında kalması ihtimaline ilişkin soruyu yanıtlayan Koç, böyle bir kararın otomotiv sanayisini ve karşılıklı ticareti derinden etkileyebileceğini söyledi. Türkiye ile Avrupa arasındaki güçlü otomotiv ilişkisine dikkat çeken Koç, olası dışlanmanın 30 yıllık kazan-kazan ilişkisini kaybet-kaybet düzeyine getirebileceğini ifade etti. Koç, değerlendirmesini şöyle sürdürdü: “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım. İnşallah Avrupa’nın o akıl tutulması, yerini aklıselime bırakır.” Sektör oyuncularının kendilerini yeniden konumlandırdığını, kendilerinin de bunu yaptığını belirten Koç, ilişkinin zayıflamak yerine güçlenmesini umduğunu söyledi. Türkiye’nin ihracatında Avrupa’nın ağırlığına dikkat çeken Koç, dışlanmanın telafisi güç sonuçlar doğurabileceğini belirtti. Çakıroğlu: Kamu alımlarında mütekabiliyet belirleyici Levent Çakıroğlu da Türkiye’de yatırımı bulunan Avrupalı üreticilerin, olası dışlanmanın değer zincirlerine vereceği zararı Avrupa’da dile getirdiğini söyledi. Avrupa’da ülkeler ve siyasetçiler arasında görüş ayrılıkları bulunduğunu belirten Çakıroğlu, kamu alımlarının kritik bir başlık olduğunu ifade etti. Çakıroğlu, “Kamu alımları konusunda mütekabiliyet olmadan Türkiye’nin bu tarife dahil edilmesi mümkün gözükmüyor. Bu çok net ifade ediliyor” dedi. Türkiye’nin bu konuda harekete geçtiğini belirten Çakıroğlu, bir müzakere sürecinin başladığını bildiğini söyledi. “Karbon için ödenecek para Türkiye’de kalsın” Ali Koç, karbon fiyatlamasının da Türkiye sanayisinin rekabet gücü açısından daha fazla tartışılması gerektiğini belirtti. Avrupa’daki karbon düzenlemelerinin bazı sektörler için önemli maliyet riski yarattığını söyleyen Koç, Türkiye’de geliştirilen sistemin Avrupa’yla uyumunun önemine işaret etti. “Bizim sistemimiz Avrupa’ya uyumlu olabilmeli ki onun sınırında ödeyeceğimiz para ülkemizde kalsın” diyen Koç, yenilenebilir enerji kullanımının üretimin karbon ayak izini düşürerek rekabet gücünü destekleyebileceğini ifade etti. Türkiye’nin kendi güneşini, rüzgârını ve suyunu kullanarak dışa bağımlılığını azaltması gerektiğini vurgulayan Koç, enerji bağımsızlığını milli güvenliğin bir unsuru olarak gördüğünü söyledi. Çakıroğlu da özellikle enerji yoğun sektörlerde dışa bağımlılığın azalmasının yatırımların daha güvenli yapılmasına katkı sağlayacağını belirterek, “Enerji konusundaki bağımsızlığı hakikaten milli güvenlikten ayrı düşünmek çok kolay değil” dedi. Çin’le yenilenebilir enerjide finansman iş birliği mesajı Çin’in yenilenebilir enerji teknolojilerinde büyük bir üretim kapasitesi oluşturduğunu belirten Koç, ülkenin teknoloji, mühendislik ve finansmanı birlikte sunmasının önemli bir rekabet avantajı sağladığını söyledi. Türkiye’de finansman maliyetlerinin yüksek olduğuna dikkat çeken Koç, Çin’le özellikle yenilenebilir enerji alanında finansman odaklı iş birliklerinin değerlendirilebileceğini ifade etti. Koç, “Dolayısıyla Çin’de fırsat yatırımdan ziyade onların finansmanlarından yararlanmak. Ülkemizde finansman şu anda çok pahalı. İş birliği yapılabilir diye düşünüyorum” dedi. Bu iş birliğinin özellikle yenilenebilir enerjide değerlendirilebileceğini söyledi. Öz tüketimde 540 MW, Entek’te 2,5 GW hedefi Topluluğun enerji yatırımlarına ilişkin bilgi veren Çakıroğlu, öz tüketim kapsamındaki lisanslarının toplamının yaklaşık 540 MW olduğunu, bunun 200 MW’tan fazlasını tamamladıklarını açıkladı. Kalan kapasitenin de aşamalı olarak devreye alınacağını söyledi. Çakıroğlu; Arçelik’in Türkiye operasyonları, Ford Otosan, TürkTraktör, Entek, Yapı Kredi ve Otokoç’un kullandıkları enerjinin tamamını yenilenebilir kaynaklardan temin ettiğini belirtti. Tüpraş’ın karbon ayak izini azaltmak amacıyla Entek üzerinden yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını sürdürdüklerini anlatan Çakıroğlu, Entek’in mevcut 478 MW yenilenebilir enerji kapasitesini 2027 sonunda 827 MW’a çıkarmayı planladıklarını söyledi. Çakıroğlu, kapasiteyi 2030’da 1,6 GW’a, 2035’te ise 2,5 GW’a yükseltmeyi hedeflediklerini belirterek hem Türkiye’de hem de Türkiye dışında yatırımları bulunduğunu ifade etti. “Son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptık” Çakıroğlu, enerji yatırımlarının yanında otomotivde elektrifikasyon çalışmalarının da sürdüğünü söyledi. Ford Otosan’ın elektrikli araçlarını, ağır kamyonların elektrifikasyonuna yönelik çalışmalarını, Otokar’ın elektrikli otobüsünü ve hidrojen yakıtlı otobüs prototipini örnek gösterdi. WAT Mobilite’nin elektrikli araç şarj ağına da değindi. Güneş paneli hücresi ve rüzgâr türbini yatırımı gibi konularda henüz belirlenmiş bir kararları bulunmadığını söyleyen Çakıroğlu, portföylerini mevcut faaliyetler ve yeni iş alanları açısından değerlendirdiklerini belirtti. Çakıroğlu, “Geçtiğimiz beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar seviyesinde yatırım yaptık. Ülkemize güveniyoruz. Ülkemizin potansiyeline inanıyoruz” diyerek fırsat gördükleri yatırımları yapmaktan çekinmediklerini vurguladı. “Ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” Ali Koç da yaz aylarında Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdiklerini söyledi. Tofaş’ın geleceği açısından önemli gördükleri K9 üretim tesisi ile Arçelik’in Manisa’daki fabrikasına değinen Koç, “Ülkemiz kadar ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” dedi. Koç, bazı şirket ve kurumların üretmeye, yatırım yapmaya ve istihdam yaratmaya var gücüyle devam ettiğini vurgulayarak, “İnşallah ikinci yüzyılımız birinci yüzyılımızdan daha parlak olur” ifadelerini kullandı. Tüpraş’a toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım Tüpraş’ın topluluğun büyük yatırım yapan şirketlerinden biri olduğunu belirten Koç, bu yatırımlar sayesinde kriz döneminde tam kapasite çalışabildiklerini söyledi. Koç, “Biz enerji güvenliğine büyük önem veriyoruz, bütün yatırımlarımız sayesinde yüzde 100 kapasitemizi kullandık” dedi. Çakıroğlu ise Tüpraş’a bugüne kadar toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptıklarını açıkladı.

Türkiye’nin bu konuda harekete geçtiğini belirten Çakıroğlu, bir müzakere sürecinin başladığını bildiğini söyledi. “Karbon için ödenecek para Türkiye’de kalsın” Ali Koç, karbon fiyatlamasının da Türkiye sanayisinin rekabet gücü açısından daha fazla tartışılması gerektiğini belirtti. Avrupa’daki karbon düzenlemelerinin bazı sektörler için önemli maliyet riski yarattığını söyleyen Koç, Türkiye’de geliştirilen sistemin Avrupa’yla uyumunun önemine işaret etti. “Bizim sistemimiz Avrupa’ya uyumlu olabilmeli ki onun sınırında ödeyeceğimiz para ülkemizde kalsın” diyen Koç, yenilenebilir enerji kullanımının üretimin karbon ayak izini düşürerek rekabet gücünü destekleyebileceğini ifade etti. Türkiye’nin kendi güneşini, rüzgârını ve suyunu kullanarak dışa bağımlılığını azaltması gerektiğini vurgulayan Koç, enerji bağımsızlığını milli güvenliğin bir unsuru olarak gördüğünü söyledi. Çakıroğlu da özellikle enerji yoğun sektörlerde dışa bağımlılığın azalmasının yatırımların daha güvenli yapılmasına katkı sağlayacağını belirterek, “Enerji konusundaki bağımsızlığı hakikaten milli güvenlikten ayrı düşünmek çok kolay değil” dedi. Çin’le yenilenebilir enerjide finansman iş birliği mesajı Çin’in yenilenebilir enerji teknolojilerinde büyük bir üretim kapasitesi oluşturduğunu belirten Koç, ülkenin teknoloji, mühendislik ve finansmanı birlikte sunmasının önemli bir rekabet avantajı sağladığını söyledi. Türkiye’de finansman maliyetlerinin yüksek olduğuna dikkat çeken Koç, Çin’le özellikle yenilenebilir enerji alanında finansman odaklı iş birliklerinin değerlendirilebileceğini ifade etti. Koç, “Dolayısıyla Çin’de fırsat yatırımdan ziyade onların finansmanlarından yararlanmak. Ülkemizde finansman şu anda çok pahalı. İş birliği yapılabilir diye düşünüyorum” dedi. Bu iş birliğinin özellikle yenilenebilir enerjide değerlendirilebileceğini söyledi. Öz tüketimde 540 MW, Entek’te 2,5 GW hedefi Topluluğun enerji yatırımlarına ilişkin bilgi veren Çakıroğlu, öz tüketim kapsamındaki lisanslarının toplamının yaklaşık 540 MW olduğunu, bunun 200 MW’tan fazlasını tamamladıklarını açıkladı. Kalan kapasitenin de aşamalı olarak devreye alınacağını söyledi. Çakıroğlu; Arçelik’in Türkiye operasyonları, Ford Otosan, TürkTraktör, Entek, Yapı Kredi ve Otokoç’un kullandıkları enerjinin tamamını yenilenebilir kaynaklardan temin ettiğini belirtti. Tüpraş’ın karbon ayak izini azaltmak amacıyla Entek üzerinden yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını sürdürdüklerini anlatan Çakıroğlu, Entek’in mevcut 478 MW yenilenebilir enerji kapasitesini 2027 sonunda 827 MW’a çıkarmayı planladıklarını söyledi. Çakıroğlu, kapasiteyi 2030’da 1,6 GW’a, 2035’te ise 2,5 GW’a yükseltmeyi hedeflediklerini belirterek hem Türkiye’de hem de Türkiye dışında yatırımları bulunduğunu ifade etti. “Son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptık” Çakıroğlu, enerji yatırımlarının yanında otomotivde elektrifikasyon çalışmalarının da sürdüğünü söyledi. Ford Otosan’ın elektrikli araçlarını, ağır kamyonların elektrifikasyonuna yönelik çalışmalarını, Otokar’ın elektrikli otobüsünü ve hidrojen yakıtlı otobüs prototipini örnek gösterdi. WAT Mobilite’nin elektrikli araç şarj ağına da değindi. Güneş paneli hücresi ve rüzgâr türbini yatırımı gibi konularda henüz belirlenmiş bir kararları bulunmadığını söyleyen Çakıroğlu, portföylerini mevcut faaliyetler ve yeni iş alanları açısından değerlendirdiklerini belirtti. Çakıroğlu, “Geçtiğimiz beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar seviyesinde yatırım yaptık. Ülkemize güveniyoruz. Ülkemizin potansiyeline inanıyoruz” diyerek fırsat gördükleri yatırımları yapmaktan çekinmediklerini vurguladı. “Ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” Ali Koç da yaz aylarında Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdiklerini söyledi. Tofaş’ın geleceği açısından önemli gördükleri K9 üretim tesisi ile Arçelik’in Manisa’daki fabrikasına değinen Koç, “Ülkemiz kadar ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” dedi. Koç, bazı şirket ve kurumların üretmeye, yatırım yapmaya ve istihdam yaratmaya var gücüyle devam ettiğini vurgulayarak, “İnşallah ikinci yüzyılımız birinci yüzyılımızdan daha parlak olur” ifadelerini kullandı. Tüpraş’a toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım Tüpraş’ın topluluğun büyük yatırım yapan şirketlerinden biri olduğunu belirten Koç, bu yatırımlar sayesinde kriz döneminde tam kapasite çalışabildiklerini söyledi. Koç, “Biz enerji güvenliğine büyük önem veriyoruz, bütün yatırımlarımız sayesinde yüzde 100 kapasitemizi kullandık” dedi. Çakıroğlu ise Tüpraş’a bugüne kadar toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptıklarını açıkladı.

Tüpraş’a toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım Ali Koç, Tüpraş’ın topluluğun büyük yatırım yapan şirketlerinden biri olduğunu belirterek bu yatırımların kriz döneminde Türkiye’nin enerji arzına katkı sağladığını ifade etti. Tüpraş’ın tam kapasite çalışmasının önemini vurgulayan Koç, “Biz enerji güvenliğine büyük önem veriyoruz, bütün yatırımlarımız sayesinde yüzde 100 kapasitemizi kullandık” dedi. articles.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
articles.summary: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
articles.summaryTr: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.
articles.articleText: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities. Bitcoin miners with power already secured could have an edge in the race to build AI data centers after voters in several US communities backed limits on new development. The midterms could also bring closer scrutiny from Congress over who pays for the grid upgrades those facilities need, industry experts told Cointelegraph. Voters in several states weighed in on data center development during the Nov. 3 US midterms, when local measures appeared on the same ballots as congressional races. Amid concerns about rising electricity costs, water use and the impact on nearby communities, voters favored limiting development in 40 of the 41 local contests tracked by Ballotpedia. The restrictions include citywide bans, limits on larger facilities, temporary pauses on new projects and voter approval requirements for some developments. The results come as major Bitcoin mining companies continue moving into AI, a transition Jamie Brown, CEO of Global Kiwi Labs, said could become more attractive as local restrictions make it harder to build new data centers. “If a Bitcoin miner has not yet repurposed their electric contract and physical plant to AI, the case to do so just got more compelling,” said Brown, whose company hosts servers for crypto exchanges and trading firms. Related: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress Local restrictions make expansion harder Miners’ shift to AI infrastructure is already underway, with publicly listed Bitcoin miners announcing more than $70 billion in AI and advanced computing contracts during 2025 and early 2026, according to a first-quarter report by CoinShares. But state and local decisions can have a more immediate impact on whether data center projects move forward. That’s because local authorities often oversee zoning and building permits and can influence access to electricity. “A company might have access to an attractive site and a significant amount of power capacity, but if local restrictions prevent it from expanding or upgrading that infrastructure, the opportunity becomes much more difficult to pursue,” said Jordan Knecht, head of strategic integrations at Kresus, a blockchain infrastructure company. Last week, voters backed 27 measures to limit or oppose new data centers in the elections, according to Ballotpedia. These included five complete bans, 12 partial bans and six-month pauses on new projects in three Maine towns. In Grove City, Ohio, voters approved a rule requiring public approval for large projects that use more than 20 megawatts of electricity, among other conditions. “Federal policy will certainly influence the broader investment environment, but the practical ability to develop and operate these facilities often comes down to conditions in individual markets,” Knecht told Cointelegraph. “For miners looking to transition into AI, I think understanding those local dynamics will be just as important as following developments in Washington.” Expanding into AI is not that simple Building AI-ready data center infrastructure can cost between $8 million and $15 million per megawatt, compared with $700,000 to $1 million per megawatt for traditional mining facilities, according to a 2026 report by CoinShares. That gap helps explain why a site with power already secured is only a starting point for miners moving into AI. “Transitioning from Bitcoin mining to AI workloads requires significant additional investment in infrastructure for cooling, networking, and reliability,” Knecht said. Yuliya Barabash, founder of SBSB Fintech Lawyers, also pointed to differences in electricity needs between Bitcoin mining and AI data centers. Bitcoin miners can often reduce electricity use when prices rise, while AI data centers typically need a consistent power supply, she said. “Higher electricity prices and additional regulatory requirements could make some projects less profitable or delay their implementation,” Barabash told Cointelegraph. This comes as electricity demand from US data centers is also expected to rise, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). The agency estimates that data centers used 224 terawatt-hours of electricity in 2025, a figure projected to nearly double to 426 terawatt-hours by 2030. The impact of Congressional changes One question facing the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress is who should pay to expand the grid for large data centers. Knecht said lawmakers could take a closer look at how those projects affect electricity costs and how they get approved. “There may be more pressure to ensure that large data center operators are paying their fair share of infrastructure costs rather than passing those expenses on to consumers.” Barabash also expects scrutiny of who pays for the electricity infrastructure needed to support data centers. “One of the key priorities is likely to be ensuring that technology companies, rather than ordinary consumers, bear the costs of the additional electricity infrastructure their facilities require,” she said. Still, experts noted that closer attention does not necessarily mean Congress will discourage data center development. “AI infrastructure is becoming increasingly important to the US economy, and there is still a strong incentive to support investment in domestic computing capacity,” Knecht said. For miners weighing a conversion, the question is whether AI revenue can justify the cost of upgrading cooling, networking and power systems. Brown thinks it can. “Miners will swap to AI because it is a better ROI than mining,” he said. Magazine: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

In Grove City, Ohio, voters approved a rule requiring public approval for large projects that use more than 20 megawatts of electricity, among other conditions. “Federal policy will certainly influence the broader investment environment, but the practical ability to develop and operate these facilities often comes down to conditions in individual markets,” Knecht told Cointelegraph. “For miners looking to transition into AI, I think understanding those local dynamics will be just as important as following developments in Washington.” Expanding into AI is not that simple Building AI-ready data center infrastructure can cost between $8 million and $15 million per megawatt, compared with $700,000 to $1 million per megawatt for traditional mining facilities, according to a 2026 report by CoinShares. That gap helps explain why a site with power already secured is only a starting point for miners moving into AI. “Transitioning from Bitcoin mining to AI workloads requires significant additional investment in infrastructure for cooling, networking, and reliability,” Knecht said. Yuliya Barabash, founder of SBSB Fintech Lawyers, also pointed to differences in electricity needs between Bitcoin mining and AI data centers. Bitcoin miners can often reduce electricity use when prices rise, while AI data centers typically need a consistent power supply, she said. “Higher electricity prices and additional regulatory requirements could make some projects less profitable or delay their implementation,” Barabash told Cointelegraph. This comes as electricity demand from US data centers is also expected to rise, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). The agency estimates that data centers used 224 terawatt-hours of electricity in 2025, a figure projected to nearly double to 426 terawatt-hours by 2030. The impact of Congressional changes One question facing the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress is who should pay to expand the grid for large data centers. Knecht said lawmakers could take a closer look at how those projects affect electricity costs and how they get approved. “There may be more pressure to ensure that large data center operators are paying their fair share of infrastructure costs rather than passing those expenses on to consumers.” Barabash also expects scrutiny of who pays for the electricity infrastructure needed to support data centers. “One of the key priorities is likely to be ensuring that technology companies, rather than ordinary consumers, bear the costs of the additional electricity infrastructure their facilities require,” she said. Still, experts noted that closer attention does not necessarily mean Congress will discourage data center development. “AI infrastructure is becoming increasingly important to the US economy, and there is still a strong incentive to support investment in domestic computing capacity,” Knecht said. For miners weighing a conversion, the question is whether AI revenue can justify the cost of upgrading cooling, networking and power systems. Brown thinks it can. “Miners will swap to AI because it is a better ROI than mining,” he said. Magazine: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

articles.title: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı sesle kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e katıldı
articles.summary: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e danışman oldu. Kullanıcıların hassas bilgilerini paylaşmadan insan olduklarını doğrulamayı hedefleyen girişim, yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar topladı.

articles.summaryTr: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e danışman oldu. Kullanıcıların hassas bilgilerini paylaşmadan insan olduklarını doğrulamayı hedefleyen girişim, yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar topladı.
articles.articleText: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı sesle kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e katıldı - Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e danışman oldu. Kullanıcıların hassas bilgilerini paylaşmadan insan olduklarını doğrulamayı hedefleyen girişim, yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar topladı. Yapay zeka çağında internette gerçek kullanıcıları botlardan ayırmak giderek zorlaşırken, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama teknolojileri öne çıkıyor. Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, kişisel bilgileri paylaşmadan kullanıcıların insan olduğunu doğrulamayı hedefleyen Helix girişimine danışman oldu. Şirket ayrıca yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar fon topladı. Helix, CAPTCHA'nın yerini alabilecek mi? CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İnternet siteleri uzun yıllardır kullanıcıların insan olduğunu doğrulamak için CAPTCHA gibi teknolojilerden yararlanıyor. Sosyal medya platformları ise son dönemde fotoğraf ve video üzerinden kimlik doğrulama yöntemlerine yöneliyor. Helix, bu yöntemlerden farklı olarak ses tabanlı bir doğrulama sistemi geliştiriyor. Teknoloji, kullanıcıların hassas kişisel bilgilerini paylaşmasına gerek kalmadan insan olduklarını kanıtlamalarını amaçlıyor. Girişimin aldığı en dikkat çekici desteklerden biri de Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus'tan geldi. Kittlaus, Helix'in danışmanları arasında yer alacak. 6,2 milyon dolarlık yatırım aldı 2025 yılında Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko ve Mike Hall tarafından kurulan Helix, Chicago Ventures liderliğindeki yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar fon topladı. Yatırım turuna BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Press On Ventures, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule 30 ve Brown Angel Group da katıldı. Kurucu ekibin teknoloji ve dijital platformlar alanında farklı deneyimleri bulunuyor. Oberg, daha önce Ticketmaster'da çalıştı ve platformun botlarla mücadele etmek amacıyla geliştirdiği Verified Fan sisteminde görev aldı. Dorofiyenko, Live Nation ve Zillow'da veri bilimi ekiplerine liderlik etti. Hall ise Nike ve Tinder'da çalıştı ve Tinder'ın ilk eşleştirme algoritmasının geliştirilmesine katkıda bulundu. Yapay zeka internet kimliğini yeniden şekillendiriyor Helix'in kurucularından Alex Oberg, yapay zeka teknolojilerinin gelişmesiyle internette gerçek kullanıcılarla yapay zeka sistemlerini birbirinden ayırmanın giderek zorlaştığını belirtiyor. Oberg'e göre bugüne kadar internet kullanıcılarının kimliği e-posta adresi, telefon numarası, IP adresi ve cihaz bilgileri gibi dolaylı veriler üzerinden doğrulanıyordu. Yapay zeka ajanlarının yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte bu yaklaşımın yeniden değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini savunan Oberg, ses gibi biyometrik sinyallerin internet kimliğinin doğrulanmasında daha önemli hale geleceğini düşünüyor. Helix de bu ihtiyaca yönelik olarak ses tabanlı bir kimlik doğrulama altyapısı geliştirmeyi hedefliyor.

articles.title: TCMB'den kredi büyümesine yeni ayar: İhtiyaç, taşıt ve KOBİ kredilerinde sınır yükseldi
articles.summary: TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: TCMB'den kredi büyümesine yeni ayar: İhtiyaç, taşıt ve KOBİ kredilerinde sınır yükseldi
articles.summaryTr: TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak.
articles.articleText: TCMB'den kredi büyümesine yeni ayar: İhtiyaç, taşıt ve KOBİ kredilerinde sınır yükseldi - TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), kredi büyüme sınırlarında değişikliğe gitti. Yeni düzenlemeyle ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırı yüzde 3'ten yüzde 3,5'e, KOBİ kredilerinde ise yüzde 5'ten yüzde 5,5'e çıkarıldı. KOBİ dışı işletme kredilerinde de sınır yüzde 2,5'e yükseltildi. İhtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde büyüme sınırı yüzde 3,5 oldu CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TCMB'nin 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli ve 2026-49 sayılı basın duyurusuna göre, tüketicilere kullandırılan ihtiyaç kredilerinde sekiz haftalık kredi büyüme sınırı yüzde 3'ten yüzde 3,5'e çıkarıldı. Taşıt kredilerinde de aynı yönde değişikliğe gidildi. Böylece tüketici kredilerinde büyüme sınırı 0,5 puan artırılmış oldu. KOBİ kredilerinde de sınırlar yükseltildi Düzenleme kapsamında işletmelere kullandırılan Türk lirası kredilerinin büyüme sınırları da artırıldı. KOBİ'lere kullandırılan TL kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırı yüzde 5'ten yüzde 5,5'e yükseltildi. KOBİ dışı işletmelere kullandırılan TL kredilerinde ise sınır yüzde 2'den yüzde 2,5'e çıkarıldı. Böylece dört kredi kategorisinin tamamında büyüme sınırları 0,5 puan artırılmış oldu. Uzun vadeli yükümlülüklerin zorunlu karşılıklarına TL ödemesi TCMB'nin açıkladığı bir diğer değişiklik ise zorunlu karşılık uygulamasına ilişkin oldu. Bankaların ve finansman şirketlerinin bir yıldan uzun vadeli, Türk lirası ve yabancı para cinsinden mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara Türk lirası cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi yapılmasına karar verildi. Merkez Bankası, değişikliklerin makrofinansal istikrarı ve parasal aktarım mekanizmasını desteklemek amacıyla gerçekleştirildiğini bildirdi. Kredi büyüme sınırlarında değişiklik

articles.title: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi
articles.summary: Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi
articles.summaryTr: Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı.
articles.articleText: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi - Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı. Apple hisseleri, teknoloji piyasasındaki sert satışlara ve faiz artışı endişelerine rağmen yükselişini sürdürerek tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyesine ulaştı. 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 değer kazanan hissede, opsiyon işlemlerinde de alım yönlü hareketlilik dikkat çekti. Apple hisselerinde rekor yükseliş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC sunucusu Jim Cramer'ın sıkça dile getirdiği "Apple'a yatırım yaparsınız, al-sat yapmazsınız" yaklaşımı, şirket hisselerinin son performansıyla yeniden gündeme geldi. Apple hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 1,79 yükselerek 354,75 dolara ulaştı. Şirketin hisseleri, kısa süreli bilanço kaynaklı düşüşe rağmen geçen hafta Covid-19'dan bu yana teknoloji hisselerinde görülen en sert satış dalgasını, yarı iletken sektöründeki ayı piyasasını ve faiz artışı endişelerini geride bıraktı. Böylece Apple'ın 2026 yılındaki toplam yükselişi yüzde 30'a ulaştı ve hisse yeni bir rekor seviyeye çıktı. Opsiyon piyasasında alım yönlü hareketlilik Apple hisselerindeki dirençli görünüm, teknoloji sektöründe güvenli liman arayan opsiyon yatırımcılarının da dikkatini çekti. Çarşamba günü seansın ilk yarısında Apple hisseleri üzerinde yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleştirildi. Bunların yaklaşık 500 bini alım (call), 370 bini ise satım (put) opsiyonlarından oluştu. Yatırımcılar ayın başında şirketin bilançosu öncesinde satım opsiyonlarına yönelmişti. Ancak hisselerin yeniden yükselişe geçmesiyle put/call açık pozisyon oranı 0,95'ten 0,87'ye geriledi. Günlük işlem hacminde ise alım opsiyonları öne çıktı. Bu tablo, Apple hisselerindeki yükselişin opsiyon piyasasında da alım yönlü beklentileri güçlendirdiğine işaret ediyor.

Yatırımcılar ayın başında şirketin bilançosu öncesinde satım opsiyonlarına yönelmişti. Ancak hisselerin yeniden yükselişe geçmesiyle put/call açık pozisyon oranı 0,95'ten 0,87'ye geriledi. Günlük işlem hacminde ise alım opsiyonları öne çıktı. Bu tablo, Apple hisselerindeki yükselişin opsiyon piyasasında da alım yönlü beklentileri güçlendirdiğine işaret ediyor.

articles.summaryTr: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.
articles.articleText: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data. Bitcoin (BTC) circled $74,000 at Wednesday’s Wall Street open as stock markets rallied and US bond yields surged. Key points: - Bitcoin failed to follow US stocks higher as CoreWeave gained up to 21% after beating Q3 revenue estimates. - The US 10-year bond yield hit a high of 5.02% on the back of higher-than-expected US CPI inflation. - BTC traded in a narrow range between its 21-week and 50-week trend lines at $73,078 and $75,492, respectively. Tech stocks rise while 10-year yield returns to 5% Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD diverging from US equities as investors resumed buying the dip in tech stocks. BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView The AI sector led the day’s early gains, with cloud-computing company CoreWeave jumping over 20% after reporting better-than-expected Q3 revenue and lifting its 2026 guidance. CoreWeave stock one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Nvidia, which suffered on Monday and Tuesday amid ongoing controversy over CEO Jensen Huang, opened around 2.5% higher. Nvidia stock one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Oil prices, meanwhile, gained on the day amid fading optimism over a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran war. As attacks on ships traversing the Strait of Hormuz continued, analysis pointed to several practical hurdles to restoring pre-conflict traffic levels, even if a deal is reached. “Even in the event a deal is struck, an increase in flows through the waterway would still depend on mine clearance, insurance costs and whether or not shipowners would even be willing to take the risk,” LSEG Oil Research wrote in a note on Tuesday, according to Reuters. US WTI crude oil was up 1.4% on the day at $87.70 per barrel after dropping to $84 on Tuesday, its lowest since late August. Brent crude gained 1.5% to $93.40. CFDs on WTI crude oil one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Stocks rose even after Tuesday’s higher-than-expected Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data pushed US bond yields sharply higher. The 10-year yield returned to 5% on Wednesday for the first time since Oct. 29, while the 30-year yield reached as high as 5.378%, a level last seen on Oct. 22. US 10-year bond yield one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer at One Point BFG Wealth Partners, said that bonds were pricing in a more hawkish approach to interest rates by the US Federal Reserve. Markets have priced in a 0.25% rate hike in December, with the odds of a 0.5% move now increasing. “Inflation breakevens today are focused on the drop in oil prices while regular Treasuries today are reacting to a Fed that is definitely going to hike next month, as of now, with one another in January,” Boockvar told CNBC. Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today BTC price stays between two key trend lines Bitcoin continued to trade in a narrow range between its 21-week and 50-week simple moving average at $73,078 and $75,492, respectively. Volatility cooled as traders awaited a new catalyst after the CPI report. BTC/USD one-day chart with 21-week and 50-week SMAs. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Investor profitability suffered as Bitcoin lost support around $75,700, the aggregate cost basis of the short-term holder (STH) cohort - entities holding a given amount of BTC without selling for up to 155 days. On Tuesday, STH wallets sent over 47,000 BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss, potentially signaling an increase in panic selling if those coins were sold.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
articles.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
articles.summaryTr: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
articles.articleText: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys. Germany’s largest lender, Deutsche Bank, launched its crypto custody service for institutional and corporate clients on Wednesday, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. The bank also signed a memorandum of understanding with Deutsche Asset Management, its majority-owned asset manager, to explore collaboration on tokenized money market funds, crypto asset exchange-traded commodities and stablecoins. Deutsche Bank announced plans to offer the service to institutional and corporate clients in Europe on Sept. 16, pending regulatory clearance. Deutsche Bank’s listing for crypto custody and transfer services in the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) register is dated Oct. 12 and names Germany’s BaFin as its regulator. The service initially supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and select stablecoins, including Circle’s USDC (USDC) and EURC (EURC), as well as AllUnity EURAU. Gerald Podobnik, co-head of Deutsche Bank’s corporate bank, told Reuters in October that the bank planned to launch in Germany before expanding to Asian financial centers in 2027. Deutsche Bank partnered with crypto infrastructure provider Taurus in 2023 to develop custody services after applying for a digital asset custody license in Germany. Related: Deutsche Bank-backed AllUnity launches Swiss franc stablecoin CHFAU

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-
articles.articleTextTr: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.title: What we know as pressure builds on embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
news.summary: The billionaire tech executive's future is in question after reports of a second extramarital affair.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: What we know as pressure builds on embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
news.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive's future is in question after reports of a second extramarital affair.
news.articleText: What we know as pressure builds on embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures could be ousted from his role amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now the firm is reportedly weighing whether to remove Huang after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Will Huang be replaced? Nvidia's board was reportedly meeting on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. The BBC called Nvidia representatives and board members for comment, but received no reply. Nvidia has 11 directors on its board, including Huang, and the CEO can be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors, according to Reuters news agency. Should Nvidia's board choose to oust Huang, or place him on leave, it was not immediately clear who might step into his shoes, even on an interim basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress could serve as interim CEO, according to analysts. Kress would be the natural choice, Armina Rosenberg, co-founder of Minotaur Capital, which holds Nvidia shares, told Reuters news agency. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. Alice Huang had previously been photographed with the Nvidia chief on several occasions. Nvidia's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with a Nvidia executive who reports directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Alice Huang, no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Bloomberg News reported that she was currently living in China. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China. Nvidia said this was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire boss's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Jensen Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth about $4tn, Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. For now, the firm's board appears unlikely to remove Jensen Huang, saying on Sunday they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. "But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

news.articleText: Dünya borsaları bu kararı bekliyordu: MSCI, 100 hisseyi endeksten çıkardı - Küresel hisse piyasalarının yakından takip ettiği MSCI endeks değişikliklerine ilişkin beklenen açıklama geldi. - Karara göre 100 hisse endeksten çıkarılırken sınır piyasalar endeksine 12 yeni hisse eklendi. Küresel endeks sağlayıcısı MSCI, Kasım 2026 dönemine ilişkin endeks değişikliklerini açıkladı. MSCI ACWI Küresel Hisse Endeksi'ne 13 yeni hisse eklenirken, 100 hissenin endeksten çıkarılmasına karar verildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle MSCI, 11 Kasım'da Londra'dan yaptığı açıklamada, küresel hisse senedi endekslerine yönelik Kasım 2026 değerlendirmesinin sonuçlarını duyurdu. Değişikliklerin tamamı 30 Kasım 2026 seans kapanışı itibarıyla uygulanacak. Moderna ve Aritzia MSCI World Endeksi'ne giriyor MSCI Global Standard Endeksleri kapsamında, MSCI ACWI Endeksi'ne 13 hisse eklenirken 100 hisse çıkarılacak. news.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

news.titleTr: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida
news.summaryTr: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
news.articleText: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida - Published A ship that was once the fastest in the world and is longer than the Titanic has intentionally been sunk off the coast of Florida, turning into the world's largest artificial ocean reef. The SS United States spent nearly 30 years docked in Philadelphia before it was moved to Florida, where it will become a home for sealife and an underwater attraction for marine enthusiasts. Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner - which crossed the Atlantic Ocean hundreds of times - to be preserved as a museum. Instead, after being purchased by a Florida county, it was added to the dozens of artificial reefs off the coast, with a land-based museum detailing the ship's history also planned. Before its retirement, the SS United States was known for carrying royalty and celebrities between the US and Europe, beginning in 1952 and ending in 1969. A young Bill Clinton, before he was president, used the ship to cross the Atlantic. Former presidents Harry Truman, Dwight Eisenhower and John Kennedy also travelled on the vessel. The ship was moved from Philadelphia to Alabama last year for cleaning and remediation work. On Monday, it took its final journey from Alabama to the coast of Destin, Florida, where it was sunk on Wednesday in a precision operation without explosives. Stars including Marlon Brando, Coco Chanel, Duke Ellington, Salvador Dali, Walt Disney, Judy Garland and Cary Grant also boarded the ship during its sailing lifetime. Before its purchase by the municipal Florida government, a number of proposals that would have seen the ship live a second life as a museum or a floating hotel failed. Instead, it sat at various docks with various owners as legal battles played out. The SS United States Conservancy group repeatedly attempted to keep the ship above water, but was unsuccessful. Conservancy President Susan Gibbs - whose grandfather helped design the liner - said she was glad that the story of the SS United States would live on. "[The ship] has always been this unabashedly American symbol that brings so many people together," Gibbs told CBS News, the BBC's US partner.
